title: Timescale Control
description: Port of Punai's Timescale Control (Workshop 3276965287) as a host callback on two observation gates: while a battle is in its combat phase (StageController._phase from PeekFirstTurnUnitPhase on, round end, battle story and battle end excluded), the value the game passes to Time.set_timeScale is multiplied by the chosen speed (1.00x to 4.00x). The game's TimeManager.Update writes Time.timeScale every frame (cur time scale, time level, slow motion), so the game's own value is scaled where it is written and nothing is set from outside; the game's own slow motion is kept and scaled with it, and outside the combat phase the value passes through unchanged. For Library of Ruina 1.0.3.

launcher.label: Timescale Control
launcher.note: Allows you to speed up the combat phase. Original mod by [Punai’s Steam Workshop](https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3276965287)

settings.label: Combat speed
settings.note: How much faster the combat phase plays. x1.00 is the normal speed, x4.00 is four times as fast.

obs._comment: main build ID -> rows {gate, offset, word, reason}; offsets are RVAs of dump.cs.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: StageController.OnFixedUpdate, second instruction (every fixed step of a battle; the entry word is the gate of max-emotion): x0 = the StageController, whose _phase (0x70) tells the planning phases (0 to 5) from the combat phases

Time.set_timeScale managed wrapper, entry (TimeManager.Update tail-calls it every frame with cur * slow factor in s0): the callback multiplies s0, saved at +256 of the gate frame, by the chosen speed while the battle is in its combat phase
